features.name: Rage
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you enter a Rage: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; a bonus to damage with Strength-based melee attacks — +2 (levels 1–8), +3 (levels 9–15), +4 (levels 16+); Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws. You can't maintain Concentration or cast spells. Lasts 10 minutes.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.desc: While you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier (a Shield is allowed).

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.desc: You can use the mastery properties of 2 kinds of weapons (increases with level).

features.name: Danger Sense
features.desc: You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects you can see (traps, spells).

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.desc: You have Advantage on Strength-based melee attack rolls on your turn, but attack rolls against you also have Advantage until your next turn.

features.name: Primal Knowledge
features.desc: An extra skill; while raging, you can make certain ability checks using Strength.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.desc: You make two attacks when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.desc: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

features.name: Instinctive Pounce
features.desc: When you enter a Rage as a Bonus Action, you can move up to half your Speed.

features.name: Brutal Strike
features.desc: When you forgo Advantage from Reckless Attack, on a hit you deal +1 damage die and apply an effect (push or slow).

features.name: Relentless Rage
features.desc: If you drop to 0 Hit Points while raging (and aren't killed), you make a Constitution saving throw and drop to 1 Hit Point instead.

features.name: Improved Brutal Strike
features.desc: An extra effect and +1 die for Brutal Strike.

features.name: Persistent Rage
features.desc: Your Rage lasts until you fall Unconscious or end it voluntarily; as a Bonus Action, you can regain Temporary Hit Points.

features.name: Indomitable Might
features.desc: If the total of a Strength check or saving throw is less than your Strength score, you can use that score instead.

features.name: Primal Champion
features.desc: Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4 (maximum 25).
